title: Precious Love
story:
A child once got separated from his parents in a busy market.

He felt scared.

People were everywhere.

Noise filled the streets.

He stood still and started crying.

A kind security guard noticed him.

He gently asked,

“Are you lost?”

The child nodded.

The guard said,

“Don’t worry. I will stay with you until your parents come.”

The child held his hand tightly.

Slowly, his fear faded.

In a few minutes, his parents found him and ran toward him.

He felt safe again.

In life, we often feel lost in chaos.

Surrounded by problems.

Confused and afraid.

But God’s love is not far away.

It is precious.

It is protective.

It becomes a refuge for those who trust Him.

And under His wings, we are safe.
life_lesson:
God’s love is your safest refuge.

When you feel lost, He is already near.
prayer:
Dear Heavenly Father,

Thank You for Your precious and unfailing love.

When I feel lost or afraid, remind me that You are with me.

Be my refuge and my strength.

Help me to rest in Your care.

In Jesus' name,
Amen.
reflection_question:
Do you feel lost or overwhelmed right now?

How does God’s love give you safety and peace?

Where do you need to trust Him more today?
verse:
How precious is Your unfailing love, O God!
People take refuge in the shadow of Your wings.
